title: TAI exact-main root controller synchronization
objective: Synchronize /usr/local/sbin/pc-tai-release-controller to the exact current-main wrapper through the existing pinned REG.RU root SSH authority after a successful exact-main full-stack release, without granting the self-hosted runner any new privilege.
boundaries: The only command is /tai sync-controller current-main on issue 3365
Commenter, actor and triggering actor must equal the repository owner
A successful exact-main Production Full-Stack Exact-SHA Release and its contract/deploy jobs are mandatory
Transport reuses the canonical REG.RU host, protected root SSH principal, normalized private key and pinned host fingerprint
The uploaded wrapper must be byte-identical to scripts/pc-tai-release-controller.sh in the protected production repository at exact current main
Only /usr/local/sbin/pc-tai-release-controller and sudoControllerSha256 in the existing runner authority marker may change
The installed controller remains root:pcactions mode 0750 and sudoers remains restricted to that single path
Previous controller and marker are restored on any failure after mutation begins
The self-hosted runner remains non-root, outside the docker group and without direct Docker access
No model, tenant, application role, financial or autonomous write authority is widened
